gaps.title: Adaptive mesh refinement with conservative coarse-fine flux refluxing
gaps.current_state: no quadtree/octree or hanging-node machinery: uniform grids only, refinement studies are done by re-running finer uniform meshes
gaps.evidence_note: grep -riE 'quadtree|octree|hanging|coarsen' over src/tensorfvm returns no AMR data structure, only prose in docstrings
gaps.acceptance: Sod on a 2-level AMR hierarchy (effective 400 cells) must match the uniform 400-cell solution in L1(rho) within 5% and conserve mass to 1e-12 via the flux-register ledger; cell count must drop by >=3x vs uniform 400
gaps.external_anchor: Sod 1978 exact Riemann solution (same anchor as the uniform-grid leg) + AMReX/Basilisk refluxing formulation

gaps.title: Implicit steady / dual-time integration (LU-SGS or Newton-Krylov)
gaps.current_state: compressible solver is explicit forward-Euler with CFL ~0.4; steady states are reached by pseudo-time marching, so high-Re and low-Mach cases are step-limited
gaps.evidence_note: EulerSolver advances with explicit time stepping (cfl=0.4 default in cases.sod); grep -niE 'implicit|newton|lusgs' in src/tensorfvm/compressible hits only the exact-Riemann Newton iteration
gaps.acceptance: on the same Sod setup restarted to a steady channel case, implicit CFL>=10 must reach the explicit converged solution within 1e-6 (L2, rho) using >=10x fewer time steps; a regression test pins the step-count ratio
gaps.external_anchor: Jameson & Turkel (1981) LU-SGS implicit formulation (as implemented in SU2/CFL3D) + the existing explicit converged state as the comparison state

gaps.title: Low-Mach preconditioning (Weiss-Smith / Turkel) for the compressible solver
gaps.current_state: no preconditioning matrix: acoustic stiffness at Ma<0.1 makes the explicit compressible path unusable for ship-scale flows, so those cases fall back to the incompressible solver
gaps.evidence_note: no low-Mach/preconditioning term anywhere in src/tensorfvm/compressible (grep 'precondition' hits only unrelated iterative-solver prose elsewhere)
gaps.acceptance: low-Mach Gresho vortex (Ma=0.05) must preserve the analytic pressure/density field within 2% and reduce the acoustic iteration count by >=5x vs unpreconditioned at the same CFL
gaps.external_anchor: Gresho & Chan 1990 vortex (analytic, incompressible limit) + SU2 preconditioning formulation

gaps.title: Rotating-frame (MRF) and arbitrary-mesh-interface (AMI) sliding boundaries
gaps.current_state: no MRF source term and no sliding/AMI interface: rotating parts (propellers, rotating cylinders) cannot be represented except by re-meshing
gaps.evidence_note: grep -riE 'sliding|MRF' over src/tensorfvm hits only the 'sliding ice' wall comment in ice_channel.py
gaps.acceptance: 2D Taylor-Couette: torque on the inner cylinder from the AMI/MRF path vs the analytic Couette torque within 3% at two gap resolutions

gaps.title: Distributed-memory domain decomposition with halo exchange
gaps.current_state: solves are single-process; torch.distributed is only consulted to pick a device, there is no domain decomposition or halo exchange for the FVM fields
gaps.evidence_note: runtime.py queries torch.distributed.is_initialized() for device selection only; no halo/exchange code in src/tensorfvm (grep 'halo' hits nothing)
gaps.acceptance: lid-cavity Re=1000 split over 2 and 4 ranks must reproduce the serial Ghia-u-centreline within 1e-6 L2 and keep parallel efficiency >=0.7 at 4 ranks on the cluster
gaps.external_anchor: Ghia et al. 1982 centreline data + serial TensorFVM run

gaps.title: Algebraic multigrid + Krylov linear solver backend
gaps.current_state: the only multigrid is the geometric V-cycle inside the immersed masked-Poisson solver; no general AMG/Krylov for the unsymmetric pressure/momentum systems
gaps.evidence_note: grep -riE 'multigrid|vcycle|amg|petsc|hypre' over src/tensorfvm hits only immersed/projection.py (masked geometric V-cycle) and docstrings
gaps.acceptance: 256^2 Poisson and an advection-diffusion system: AMG-PCG iteration count must grow <=1.3x from 64^2 to 256^2 and solve to 1e-10 in fewer than 30 iterations
gaps.external_anchor: Brandt (1977) multigrid h-independence + BoomerAMG convergence data (Baker et al. 2012)

gaps.title: Multi-species transport with stiff Arrhenius chemistry
gaps.current_state: the compressible solver carries at most two materials with a stiffened-gas EOS; there is no species transport, no reaction source and no operator splitting for stiff chemistry
gaps.evidence_note: grep -riE 'combust|chemistry|species' hits only the two-material 'species' bookkeeping in the compressible package
gaps.acceptance: 1D premixed CH4/air flame: laminar flame speed within 10% of the Cantera reference at two resolutions
gaps.external_anchor: Cantera (Goodwin et al. 2017) laminar flame speed for the same mechanism

gaps.title: Radiative heat transfer (P1 / discrete ordinates) coupled to the energy equation
gaps.current_state: no radiation model: the energy equation has conduction and convection only
gaps.evidence_note: no radiation module; docs/verification-gap-audit-m7555.md already lists radiation as an unverified capability gap
gaps.acceptance: 1D grey parallel plates: net radiative flux vs the analytic exchange factor within 2%; coupling conserves total energy to 1e-10
gaps.external_anchor: analytic view-factor exchange for infinite parallel plates (Incropera & DeWitt 2007, Ch. 13)
